caption: The drawing contains two main objects on a plain off-white background. In the upper left quadrant of the drawing, there is a detailed depiction of four dark brown, vertical, carved wooden balusters placed between two horizontal wooden rails, forming a small rectangular section. Below and slightly to the right, occupying most of the lower half of the image, is a rectangular section outlined in black, filled with a pattern of reddish-orange rectangular bricks. The brick section is bordered with black lines indicating different levels or layers, with the brickwork forming a recessed, rounded and stepped area in the center, as well as a raised, tiered feature at the upper center of the section. The bricks are drawn with even, light brown mortar lines. There are short, black angled lines marking points of detail at some corners and along the bottom edges of the brickwork. At the bottom left corner, the scale “Scale 1/4\" = 1'” is written in small script, and at the bottom right corner, the name “HOWARD H. SHERIIR JR.” is printed in blue.
title: Steps Leading to Chancel Rail and Detail of Railing, San Luis Rey Mission Church
